ability.name: Confirm and Install Nmap
ability.description: Checks if nmap is installed, and installs it via winget or choco if missing.

stages.command_template: if not exist C:\Windows\Temp\bas mkdir C:\Windows\Temp\bas && (where nmap >nul 2>&1 || winget install -e --id Insecure.Nmap --silent --accept-package-agreements --accept-source-agreements || choco install nmap -y) && nmap --version > C:\Windows\Temp\bas\nmap_version.txt

rationale: Ensures nmap is available on the foothold host, installing it via native package managers if missing.
